items.title: AI Agents Still Need Middlemen. But Will They Need Amadeus?
items.snippet: Skift Take: Amadeus has the scale and airline relationships, but those advantages don't guarantee it a direct role in AI-agent bookings. Amadeus has spent decades connecting airlines with travel sellers. AI agents may change how customers shop, but somebody still has to find flights, complete bookings, and handle changes.

items.title: Aviation’s Next Disaster Could Be In Your Carry-On
items.snippet: Skift Take: Battery incidents are rising and airlines are tightening restrictions, with cabin crews the last line of defense. Is the industry doing enough to prevent the next fire, or simply getting better at putting them out? The culprit was small enough to fit in a pocket, but the consequences were big enough to turn a Boeing 777 around over the Atlantic.

items.title: India Relaxes Passport Rules for Select Foreign Nationals
items.snippet: The Ministry of Home Affairs has amended immigration rules to extend exemptions from passport and travel document requirements to several categories of foreign nationals residing in India, including certain Pakistani citizens, minority communities from neighbouring countries, registered Sri Lankan Tamil refugees and Tibetans.

items.title: HP: Tourism employees' union, BJP opposes proposed PPP transfer of Peterhoff
items.snippet: The Himachal Pradesh government faces a plea from the Tourism Corporation Employees' Union regarding Hotel Peterhoff. Union general secretary Raj Kumar emphasised the hotel's capacity to generate significant revenue. Concerns are mounting about a potential transfer to private management via a Public-Private Partnership model, igniting criticism from BJP members who highlight the hotel's historical significance.

items.title: Chiang Mai Cancels Flights Ahead of Lantern Festival
items.snippet: Chiang Mai International Airport in Thailand has announced 108 flight cancellations and schedule changes to another 80 services ahead of the annual Yi Peng and Loy Krathong festivals. The operational adjustments will remain in place from November 21 to 28, 2026, as authorities prepare for an estimated 200,000 sky lanterns and smoke balloons expected to be released during the celebrations.

items.title: Karnataka Plans Mobile Museum Showcasing Western Ghats Biodiversity
items.snippet: Karnataka is planning to introduce a mobile museum dedicated to showcasing the unique biodiversity of the Western Ghats, with a specially designed Volvo bus travelling across the state to reach different sections of society.

items.title: Airbnb Sells IP to AI Lab Owned by Its CEO and CTO
items.snippet: Skift Take: Airbnb’s CEO and CTO both own part of the lab buying its IP, but the filing gives shareholders little detail on what changed hands. Airbnb sold intellectual property to a private AI lab founded and controlled by CEO Brian Chesky. CTO Ahmad Al-Dahle also holds a stake in the lab, and both executives work for the entity.

items.title: Coca-Cola's India bottler Hindustan Coca-Cola files for IPO
items.snippet: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings, India's largest Coca-Cola bottler, has filed for an initial public offering consisting entirely of a stake sale by its majority shareholder, with no fresh money going to the company, draft papers showed.

items.title: Dusit Hotels and Resorts opens two distinctive hotels in Yangon, Myanmar
items.snippet: Dusit Hotels and Resorts, the hotel arm of Thailand-based Dusit International, has officially opened two properties in Yangon, Myanmar, under its management. The Strand Hotel Yangon – Dusit Collection and ASAI Yangon Sule offer distinct hospitality experiences, combining heritage luxury and contemporary lifestyle accommodation with the group’s Thai-inspired hospitality.
